en: An old sepia-toned illustrated postcard with ornate floral frames around four small photographic views. The central large script reads "Gruss aus Dorpat". The upper-left image is labeled "Universitäts Bibliothek" showing a classical building. The upper-middle image reads "Garten des Handwerker-Vereins" depicting a formal garden with a fountain or statue. The upper-right view is labeled "Domallee" showing a tree-lined avenue with a bridge or walkway. The lower-left is labeled "Mollatz" with a countryside or villa scene. The card is heavily filled with handwritten German text around and over the images.
